notes.title: Custom Goban Beta is here!
notes.notes:
Get ready to master your moves on the board!  🎮

We're launching our Beta Testing program for Custom Goban, and we need YOUR help to make it the best Go game ever! Be one of the first to experience its amazing features, and shape the future of Custom Goban. 

Ready to join the team? Fill out this quick form: [url=https://forms.gle/7GnyecAW9qPXucVL6]https://forms.gle/7GnyecAW9qPXucVL6[/url]

Your feedback is crucial as we polish Custom Goban to perfection. Let's make Go history together!  🚀

notes.title: The Best Way to learn Go
notes.notes:
Custom Goban is based on the [i]rules of the game of Go.[/i] So the better you play Go, the more fun you will have with Custom Goban. To this end, we are proud to introduce our partner [url=https://gomagic.org/?utm_source=go_websites&utm_campaign=customgoban]GoMagic[/url], a modern platform for learning Go.

On the platform, you will find carefully-structured [b]video lessons[/b] with matching practical exercises. A [b]skill tree[/b] with a single [b]gaming system[/b] lets you have fun when solving problems and find possible weaknesses in your play at the same time.

You can visit the GoMagic website to learn more: [url=https://gomagic.org/?utm_source=go_websites&utm_campaign=customgoban]https://gomagic.org[/url]
